title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
description: Discover free social spaces and activities at Aurora University, from museum galleries and quiet study lounges to student-led events and athletic games.

cards.title: Browse Native American Art
cards.subtitle: Hill Welcome Center
cards.notes: Visit this Smithsonian-affiliated museum to view over 6,000 pieces of Native American art and artifacts. Admission is free for all visitors.
cards.short_summary: A free art museum and gallery located within the Hill Welcome Center featuring extensive Native American collections.
cards.evidence_claim: Admission is FREE, but donations are welcome!
cards.source_title: Hours, Admission, and Location - Aurora University
cards.access_notes: Open Monday-Friday 9 a.m.–5 p.m. (Tuesdays until 7 p.m.). Closed during summer months.

cards.title: Collaborate in the Library
cards.subtitle: First Floor Social Zone
cards.notes: Use the first floor for group projects and social study. Rolling whiteboards allow you to create mobile meeting spaces with friends.
cards.short_summary: The collaborative first floor of the campus library designed for group work and social interaction.
cards.evidence_claim: The first floor encourages collaborative group work and popular among students are the rolling white boards.
cards.source_title: Student Services - Academic Catalogs < Aurora University
cards.access_notes: Open until 9 p.m. Monday-Thursday and Sunday during the semester.

cards.title: Play Pool and Ping Pong
cards.subtitle: Stephens Hall
cards.notes: Head to this student hangout to play ping pong or pool, watch TV, or use the computer stations between classes.
cards.short_summary: A central student lounge in Stephens Hall equipped with games, TVs, and social seating.
cards.evidence_claim: The Spartan Spot is a place for students to hang out and play ping pong or pool, watch TV.
cards.source_title: Guide for New Students and Families - Aurora University
cards.access_notes: Located in Stephens Hall; typically open during building hours for all students.

cards.title: Attend a Free Concert
cards.subtitle: Institute for Collaboration
cards.notes: Catch a performance by the AU Chorale or a guest lecturer. Many events in the Arts and Ideas series are complimentary.
cards.short_summary: A 500-seat venue hosting free musical performances, lectures, and cultural events for the community.
cards.evidence_claim: The Celebrating Arts and Ideas series offers unique cultural experiences, free of charge.
cards.access_notes: Check the university calendar for specific event times; many are open to the public.

cards.title: Cheer for the Spartans
cards.subtitle: Athletic Events
cards.notes: Show your student ID for free admission to regular season home games for football, soccer, and lacrosse.
cards.short_summary: The primary on-campus athletic field where students can attend home games at no cost.
cards.evidence_claim: AU Students, Faculty and Staff Free with college ID.
cards.access_notes: Free for students with a valid AU ID card during regular season games.

cards.title: Reflect and Study
cards.subtitle: Wackerlin Center for Faith and Action
cards.notes: Gather here for quiet reflection or group study. The center also offers free beverages and snacks daily for students.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated space for faith, service, and reflection that provides free refreshments to the student body.
cards.evidence_claim: Wackerlin Center for Faith and Action* ... *Free beverages and/or snacks available daily.
cards.access_notes: Located at 430 S. Evanslawn Ave. Open during standard university business hours.

cards.title: Find Professional Attire
cards.subtitle: Hill Center for Student Success
cards.notes: Browse a selection of free professional clothing, shoes, and accessories to prepare for your next job interview.
cards.short_summary: An on-campus resource providing complimentary business attire to students for professional development.
cards.evidence_claim: Spartan Attic is an on-campus clothes closet that provides complimentary professional clothing.
cards.access_notes: Open 8 a.m.–5 p.m. or by appointment in the Hill Center for Student Success.

cards.title: Relax on the Lawn
cards.subtitle: Central Campus
cards.notes: Enjoy the main outdoor green space for socializing, lawn games, or attending large-scale campus events like Welcome Week.
cards.short_summary: The central outdoor hub of campus used for student gatherings and major university events.
cards.evidence_claim: The Quad is the outdoor space in the center of campus where commencement ceremonies and many other events are held.
cards.source_title: Guide for New Students and Families - Aurora University

cards.title: Study in the Atrium
cards.subtitle: John C. Dunham Hall
cards.notes: Utilize the open atrium for a quiet place to hang out between classes. Laptop loaner kiosks are available nearby.
cards.short_summary: A bright, open indoor space in Dunham Hall ideal for individual study and quiet breaks.
cards.evidence_claim: Quiet Areas ... Dunham Hall Atrium; John C. Dunham Hall.
cards.access_notes: Accessible during building hours; includes microwave and computer access.

cards.title: Join Student Activities
cards.subtitle: Various Campus Locations
cards.notes: Participate in free student-led activities like outdoor movies, arts and crafts, or large-scale magic shows throughout the year.
cards.short_summary: A wide range of social events organized by SPEAR and Campus Life that are free for all AU students.
cards.evidence_claim: Unless otherwise advertised, all Campus Life-sponsored events are free of cost to AU students.
cards.source_title: Campus Life Events FAQs - Aurora University
cards.access_notes: Events occur frequently; check the AU calendar or @spearau on Instagram for schedules.
